objectives_fil: Makakalap ng kaugnay na impormasyon gamit ang bukas na tanong at pakikinig na may respeto.
Masusuri ang impormasyon sa paghihiwalay ng sinabi, nakita at hindi pa nakukumpirma.
Makapagtatala at makapaglalahad ng maikling ulat sa tamang tatanggap na may malinaw na susunod na hakbang.
Maipapaliwanag ang isang mensahe sa payak na salita at masusuri ang linaw nito sa sariling paliwanag ng kausap.
objectives_en: Gather relevant information using open questions and respectful listening.
Assess information by distinguishing reports, observations and unconfirmed details.
Record and present a short report to the appropriate recipient with a clear next step.
Explain a message in plain language and check its clarity through the person’s own explanation.
summary_fil: Sa usapan nina Mila at Liza, ang nawawalang sagot ay hindi pinunan ng hula. Lumitaw ang hadlang nang magkaroon ng pribadong lugar, bukas na tanong at oras makinig. Ang sinabi, nakita at hindi tiyak ay pinaghiwalay bago iniulat. Nagkaroon ng magagamit na plano nang malinaw ang tatanggap, aksyon at balik-paliwanag. Iyan ang tulay mula sa kuwento ng residente tungo sa tulong ng health team.
summary_en: In Mila and Liza’s conversation, missing answers were not replaced with guesses. Privacy, open questions and time to listen brought the barrier into view. Reports, observations and uncertainty were separated before the handoff. A usable plan emerged through a clear recipient, action and teach-back. This connects a resident’s account with help from the health team.
